R1.quantity: wall interface-1 temperature T_i1 [K], conductance-weighted mean of the two cells adjacent to the interface face (the parent's reader form)
R1.band_rule: T9a's registered row rule, unchanged: CONVERGING -> band = the triple's own GCI (Fs 1.25, unequal ratios from cell counts, dim 1); EXACT -> T9a's 'zero band grades only a literally exact value' made operational as the absolute floor below; other states NOT A RESULT
R1.floor_ground: a piecewise-linear exact solution is in the null space of the harmonic scheme's truncation error, so the triple is predicted EXACT; scratch (2026-08-26, outside the repository) measured |T_i1 - exact| = 5.7e-14 K at c and 2.9e-12 K at f; the floor 1e-6 K is ~1000x the round-off and 900x TIGHTER than T9a's R1 band of 0.92 mK -- no widening
R1.roundoff_ground: a triple whose level differences |e21|, |e32| are both below 1e-9 K is classified EXACT (T9a's byte-identical EXACT made operational: the harmonic scheme reproduces the exact solution to ~1e-12 K, not to the bit); above it the imported roache_triple classifier rules

reported_rows.R0: hot-face flux q, relative deviation from the series-resistance q; REPORTED, not graded (T9a's R0 PASSED at 1.8 percent under linear; predicted exact under harmonic)

C_MAP.what: every cell's DT equals the registered layer conductivity for its centre position (the parent's C_MAP)

C_SCHEME.what: CASE.txt and system/fvSchemes on disk carry the harmonic scheme; the parent's linear scheme is REFUSED

C_REF.what: the referent derived from the series-resistance law is cross-checked to T9a's registered T_i1 and q to 1e-6; a 1 mK planted error is REFUSED (selftest)

C_PZ.what: planted-zero control (rule 3): one-cell plant in the cell adjacent to interface 1 (the point reader's own station), both arms, measured ladder, refuses a blind/noisy reader or a read below 0.1 x plant
